Class PlayerDTO

java.lang.Object
it.polimi.ingsw.network.dto.PlayerDTO
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable
public class PlayerDTO extends Object implements Serializable
Represents a player as seen by the client.

Carries the player's identity (nickname and pawn color) together with their current hand of building and character cards. Returned defensive copies of the card lists to prevent accidental mutation.
